jobs.name: companions-fullbody-v1
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a production 2D game sprite atlas. Reference image is the existing identity and art-style sheet for three companions. Keep the exact TOP ROW character identities, recognizable facial features, ages, hair, clothing, color palette and equipment. Create one NEW landscape transparent atlas with THREE FULL-BODY standing travel sprites in three equally wide columns, a single row, consistent scale, common feet baseline, all heads, hands, boots and every carried item fully visible, generous transparent gutters between characters. Left column: Alan, the young female guard with dark high ponytail, dark lamellar armour and red scarf. Middle column: He, the young male courier with dark topknot, blue patterned headband, indigo travel robes and rolled bedroll backpack. Right column: Du, the older grey-haired bearded smith with indigo rolled sleeves and a worn brown leather apron. Each stands naturally in a calm determined travelling pose facing slightly toward viewer-left, hands relaxed near the waist rather than extended like an order-giver. No weapons in their hands, no lantern core, no forged sword, no extra characters. Extend the original costumes naturally into matching trousers, boots and full lower bodies. Preserve the original detailed Chinese hand-painted adventure-game style, dark ink contours and warm orange edge lighting. No background, no ground plane, no drop shadows baked into the image, no writing, no UI, no labels, no crop. Truly transparent alpha. Do not reproduce the bottom row or half-body crop from the reference. This is a three-column full-body sprite atlas, not a scene or poster.
